content: Kura Ketsutsi kemɨtiyetuanikekai
Merikɨtsɨ Paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka 'ixɨarariyari kanahurakaitɨni, Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari mɨtitewakai.
Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai tixaɨtɨ mekatenikuwautɨwekaitɨni Ketsutsi kememɨtemienikekai, teɨteri mewamakatɨ.
Hikɨ Kauyumarie Kura 'Itsikariutitanaka hetsie kaneutahani, mɨkɨ tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta mɨwanɨkai.
Heyaka mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta wakuyaxima wahetsɨa, katiniwarutaxatɨani Ketsutsi kemɨtiwayetuirienikekai.
Mɨkɨ mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni, mekaniuyu'enieni kename tumini me'i'ɨitɨanikekai.
Mɨkɨta yakatiniutanaki'erieni, hikɨ katinikuwaunekaitɨni kepauka 'aixɨa mɨyɨnikekai mɨwayetuirienikɨ teɨteri me'umawekaku.
Ti'aitame 'ikwaiya
Merikɨtsɨ kepauka Paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka 'ixɨarariyari maye'a, kepauka muxa nunutsi mutimemieriwa Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari hetsiemieme.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi kaniwarutanɨ'ani Pekuru meta Wani mɨpaɨ tiwarahɨawetɨ: —Xekenehu 'aixɨa xeketenekuyuri Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari temekwanikɨ.
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Hakewa pɨmatsihenake 'aixɨa temɨtehekuyurienikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xeme xeheutahaxɨaximekaku kiekaritsie tewi mana pɨxe'anukunake ye'ɨ 'ahanatɨ hekuhanɨka. Mɨkɨ xekenanuweiya kiita hakewa meutahani.
Mɨpaɨ xeketenetahɨawi kiekame: “Ti'ɨkitame mɨpaɨ paine: ¿Hakewa kii mɨkɨ muwa nemɨtiwa'ɨkitɨa wahamatɨa Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari nemukwani?”
Mɨkɨ kii taɨta xeheutiwitɨme kanixexeitsitɨamɨkɨ hipame kii 'amuyeyewa naitɨ 'ureyepikame. Muwa 'aixɨa xeketeneyuri.
Hikɨ mekanekɨne, mekaneitaxeiya kemɨtiwarutahɨawixɨ. Muwa Patsikwa 'ikwaiyari hetsiemieme 'aixɨa mekateniukuyurieni.
Hikɨ 'aye'aku, mexatsie kaniutiyerɨni meta nɨ'arimama yaxeikɨa.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kwinimieme nepihiwe'eriekai xehamatɨa 'ikɨ 'ixɨarari 'ikwaiyari nemɨkwanikɨ nekatikwiniwetɨ 'akuxi.
Yanepɨtixekɨhɨawe, tawari 'ikɨ nepɨkakwani mexi ka'aye'awe tita 'ixɨarari mɨti'inɨariyari Kakaɨyari ti'aitametɨkaku.
Hikɨ tekɨxi 'anuhanaka pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨaka Kakaɨyari mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Xekenanuhani 'ikɨ, yuxexuitɨ xekenanuti'inɨataxɨa.
Mɨpaɨ nepɨxerahɨawe, tawari kaxie hayari nepɨka'anu'ieni mexi ka'aye'awe Kakaɨyari mitsutɨani ti'aitatɨ.
Hikɨ paa 'anu'ɨka pamɨpariyutsi 'ipitɨaka Kakaɨyari 'ititaraka kaniwarumini mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Ikɨ kaninewaiyaritɨni xehetsiemieme mɨyetuiyani, 'ipaɨ xeketeneyurieka xemɨnetsiha'eriwanikɨ.
Yaxeikɨata katiniuyurieni tekɨxi hepaɨtsita mete'ukwaku, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ikɨ tekɨxita mieme tɨratu mɨhekwa kanihɨkɨtɨni nexuriyakɨ 'aixɨa mɨ'itɨarieni, xehetsiemieme kemɨtitayeuriyani.
Perutsɨ kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiyetuani 'ena paka, mamaya mexatsie pama hakewa nemaka.
Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa, nekaniyemieni nemɨmierienikɨ, kemɨti'aitsie yamɨtiyɨnikɨ, perutsɨ xɨa'ui kemɨ'ane mɨnetsiyetuani.
Mɨkɨ mekanitsutɨani niuki mexɨatɨatɨ kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ mɨxatakai kename mɨya tiyurienikekai 'utaitɨ.
Metatsiereta meyuniukimatɨ mekanakɨne kemɨ'ane mɨkɨ matsi waɨkawa meuyewetse mayanikekai.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Nuiwarite tewa'aitɨwamete mekateniwa'uxitɨaka yuteɨterima, meta mɨkɨ wahetsie 'itsɨkate memɨhɨkɨ yuhetsiemieme mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuaneni kename 'aixɨa meteyuruwamete.
Xeme pɨta mɨpaɨ xepɨkayɨaka. 'Apɨta, kemɨ'ane xeme mɨmariwe mɨkɨ kemɨ'ane tixaɨtɨ mɨkatihɨkɨ hepaɨ keyɨaneni, meta kemɨ'ane mɨtixe'aitɨa mɨkɨ kemɨ'ane xehetsiemieme mɨti'uximaya hepaɨ keyɨaneni.

Kexeteku'eriwa, ¿kemɨ'ane matsi pumariwe, kemɨ'ane kiekametɨtɨ mɨtikwa'a, kemɨ'ane miparewie timikwatɨ, mɨkɨ nutsu pumariwe? Xɨari kiekame matsi pumariwe. Perutsɨ ne xetsata nepuyeika xehetsiemieme neti'uximayatɨ pɨta.
Xeme nehetsie xekateniwiyakaitɨni xekatehayewatɨ ne'inɨatsienekaku.
Ne'ukiyari kemɨnerayeitɨa ti'aitame, neta yaxeikɨa te'aitamete nekanixe'ayeitɨamɨkɨ.

Nehamatɨa xekatenikwaikuni xekateni'ikuni mexa 'aurie ne'akaime neti'aitametɨkaku, 'itsɨkate xekanakɨnikuni, 'uwenitsie xe'ayaxeme xekateniwa'aitɨakakuni teɨteri tamamata heimana huta 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama.
»Neuxei, Tsimuni, yumarima 'aixɨa, Kauyumarie pɨxe'uta'iwau, pɨxeta'inɨata, pɨxetikatse tɨriku hepaɨ.
Ne matsi nepɨnetanenewi 'ahetsiemieme pemɨkatihayewakɨ yuri peti'erietɨ. 'Ekɨta kepauka pemɨtihayewa peheuyewautsetɨ keniwatuikani 'a'iwama».
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ti'aitame, nepɨnewaɨriya 'ahetsie nemɨtiwiyani tsepa nemanutahɨiya tsepa nemumierie.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Pekuru 'aku, mɨpaɨ nepɨmatikɨhɨawe, wakana katahiwawekaku 'akuxi hikɨ, 'ekɨ haikakɨa pekani'aku'imawamɨkɨ, kename pekanetsimate pe'utaitɨ.
Hikɨ mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe: —Kepauka nemɨxeheutanɨ'axɨa kɨtsiuri, xerai, kakai xekate'upikame, ¿tixaɨ xeteheuyehɨakai 'aku? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Tixaɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Hikɨtsɨ pɨta mɨpaɨ pɨkatiyɨni, kemɨ'ane kɨtsiuri mexeiya keheihurieni, xerai meta yaxeikɨa. Kemɨ'ane mɨkaheixeiya kuya kutsiraya yɨ'ɨkari ke'utuani ke'inaneni.
Yanepɨtixekɨhɨawe, peuyewetse nehetsie maye'atɨarienikɨ mɨpaɨ kemɨre'uxa: “'Inɨari niukiyari tsanamete wahepaɨ kaniu'itɨarieni”. Naitɨ nehepaɨtsita kemɨre'uxa kanaye'atɨarieximeni.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Ti'aitame, neuxei 'ena kutsirate hutatɨ. Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Neuxei 'ariri.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiyutanenewi Ketitsemanitsie
Merikɨtsɨ wayeyaka kaneyani hakewa me'axekai Huriwa Maku'u yemuriyaritsie, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaniweiyakaitɨni.
Hikɨ muwa heta'aka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: «Xekeneyunenewieka, kapa 'axaxete'uyurienikɨ xemɨta'inɨatsienitsie».
Hikɨ yuxaɨta kananayeyani memakutekaitsie yatewa kaniuyani tete kemɨrehɨiwa yakɨtɨtɨ, 'utitunumakeka kaniyutanenewieni,
mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: «Ne'ukiyari, xɨka pe'awaɨriyani, yanepɨra'eriwakaku mɨka'aye'anikɨ kenemɨtikwinitɨarieni, matsi kemɨnetinake ne pɨkatixaɨ, kemɨmatinake 'ekɨ pɨta yaketiuyɨni».
Hikɨ niuki tuayame matsiɨkɨtɨ kanayuyeitɨani hɨxiena taheima mieme 'itɨrɨkariyatɨ.
Hikɨ kwiyɨanetɨ hiwerikakɨ, matsi kwini mieme yutatuatɨ kaniyunenewiekaitɨni, kwaxiyaya xuriya tsuniriyari hepaɨ kani'anenekaitɨni kwiepa kaxɨrɨwetɨ.
Kepauka mɨtiutahayewaxɨ yunenewietɨ 'anukukeka teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete wahetsɨa nuaka mana kaniwarutaxeiya mekutsume hiwerikakɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —¿Titayari xetekutsu? Xekenanuku'uti xekeneyunenewieka kapa 'axaxete'uyurienikɨ xemɨta'inɨatsienitsie.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiuwiyarie
Merikɨte 'utaniukakaku 'akuxi yumɨiretɨ teɨteri mekaniu'axɨani, xewitɨ kaniwarawitɨkɨkaitɨni tamamata heimana memɨyuhuta mɨwanɨkai Kura titewatɨ. Ketsutsi 'aurie kaniutakeni 'i'itsenike.
Peru Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kura, ¿penetsi'itseme penetiyetuani Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa?
Teɨterimama metemarietɨ kemɨtiyɨanekai mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Ti'aitame, ¿takutsiratekɨ tetewatakwini?
Xewitɨ mɨkɨ tewi mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa mieme ti'uximayatame nakaya kanawiteni tserietana mieme.
Peru Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ari xeketeneuhayewa. Hikɨ 'imayɨaka nakaya 'aixɨa kaniuyurieni.

Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete, kuyaxi tukipa miemete, meta 'ukirawetsixi memeyekɨ me'iwiyake: —¿Kari xepeyekɨ 'ixiparate meta kɨyexite xete'u'ɨtɨ xenetsiwiyake, kemɨtiwiwiyarɨwa tinawayame?
Tukarikɨ xehetsɨa ne'uyeikakaku tukipa xepɨkanetsi'umayɨa. Peru hikɨ xetukari kanihɨkɨtɨni yamɨtiyɨnikɨ, Yɨwikame heitserie pexeiya hikɨ.
Pekuru kemɨtiyuku'imawakai
Merikɨte me'iwiyaka mekaneihana mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame kiita mekani'atɨani. Pekuru kaniweiyakaitɨni yatewa.
Hikɨ takwa hixɨapa metinaika mana mekaniutiyaxe meta Pekuru wahamatɨa kaniutiyerɨni.
Hikɨ xewitɨ 'ɨimari mana mɨti'uximayakai 'ixeiyaka hekɨaripa 'ukaime 'ixeiyatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ikɨta hamatɨana kaniuyeikakaitɨni.
Mɨkɨ kaniyuku'imawakaitɨni mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Uka 'aku, ne nepɨka'imate.
Yareutewikakuta xewitɨ 'ixeiyaka mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ekɨtsɨ xewitɨ mɨkɨ wa'iwa pekanihɨkɨtɨni. Pekuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Tewi, ne nepɨkahɨkɨ.
Hikɨ xeihurayari 'aye'aku yakɨtɨniketɨ xewitɨta heitseriemekɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Yurikɨ 'ikɨ hamatɨana kaniuyeikakaitɨni, neuxei Karereya kiekame kanihɨkɨtɨni.
Pekuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Tewi, ne 'atsinepɨkatimate kepemaine. Yapauka haniukakaku 'akuxi, wakana kenetahiwa.

Ti'aitame ta'aurie 'aweka kaneutaniere Pekuru kaniuxeiya. Hikɨ Pekuru Ti'aitame niukieya kanaye'erieni kemɨtitahɨawixɨ: «Wakana katahiwawekaku 'akuxi hikɨ, 'ekɨ haikakɨa pepɨ'aku'imawani kename pekanetsimate pe'utaitɨ».
Wayeyaka kaniutatsuani kwini mieme tiyuhiwerietɨ.
Ketsutsi kemɨtinanaimariekai kemɨtikuweiwakai
Hikɨ teɨteri Ketsutsi memɨ'ɨwiyakai mekanitsutɨani me'inanaimatɨ meta mekanikuwayakaitɨni.
Hɨxiena meheikɨhɨaka, mekanikuwayakaitɨni, meta mɨpaɨ mekateniku'iwawiyakaitɨni: —Ketatineutahekɨatɨa, kemɨ'ane pɨmatsi'uwa.
Waɨkawa matsi mɨpaɨ mekatenikɨhɨawekaitɨni 'axame'utiyuatɨ.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiutahɨawarie 'itsɨkate wahɨxie
Merikɨtsɨ 'ukatareku mekaniyukuxeɨrieni teɨteri wa'ukiyarima meta mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete, meta 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai, mɨkɨ mekani'atɨani memayuxeɨriekaitsie.
Mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —Ketatineutaxatɨa, xɨka 'ekɨ Kɨritsitu pehɨkɨtɨni. Mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —Xɨka yanetixe'utahɨawe, yuri xepɨkaneteta'eririeni.
Xɨka nexeku'iwawiyanike xepɨkanetsita'eiyakeyu, meta xepɨkanetsixɨnakeyu.
Peru hikɨtɨtɨ Yuri Tewi kenemɨtitewa Kakaɨyari Naimekɨmɨtɨrɨkaɨye tserieta nepakani.
Yunaitɨ mɨpaɨ mekatenitahɨawe: —'Aa, ¿'ekɨ xeniu Kakaɨyari petinu'aya? Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Xemetsɨ mɨpaɨ xekaniutiyuaneni kename nehɨkɨ.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —¿Ketitayari 'akuxi tetewareuyehɨwa tehekɨatamete? tametsietɨ tepi'eni tetana mieme.
